system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: shcportal_get_nutrient_values and shcportal_filter_reports_by_land. For your information, my land_parcel_id is dummy_land_parcel_id_9269, my aadhaar_number is 100020004568, my report_id is dummy_report_id_1154.

function.name: shcportal_filter_reports_by_land
function.description: Filters SHC reports for a specific land parcel across all available years. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate reports. Fails if land_parcel_id is invalid or no reports exist for that parcel.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier for a land parcel.

function.name: shcportal_get_nutrient_values
function.description: Retrieves specific nutrient analysis values from a generated report. Values include nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, organic carbon, pH, and micronutrients. Lab-measured and immutable. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide recommendations. Fails if report is not generated or nutrient data is partial.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

report_id.description: Unique identifier of the SHC report.
